import json,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
root=Path.cwd(); task=root/'.ai/task/repair-w68-20261012'
work=json.loads((task/'WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
allowed={(e['normalized_path'],e['section'],e['source'],e['source_tag']):e for e in work}
adj=json.loads((task/'ADJUDICATION-R1.json').read_text()); findings=[e for e in adj['findings'] if e['status']=='confirmed']; assert len(findings)==1
finding=findings[0]; item=next(e for e in work if e['entry_revision_identity']==finding['revision_key'])
files=sorted({e['normalized_path'] for e in work}); snapshot=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='w68-r2-'))
for name in files: (snapshot/name).write_bytes((root/name).read_bytes())
path=root/item['normalized_path']; before=path.read_bytes(); old,new=finding['fix']; assert before.count(old.encode())==1
path.write_bytes(before.replace(old.encode(),new.encode(),1))
assert path.read_bytes()==before.replace(old.encode(),new.encode(),1)
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest())); counts={}; delta=[]; changed=[]
clean=lambda r:{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='line'}
for name in files:
 baseline=loader.load_path(task/'baseline'/name,logical_path=name).records
 pre=loader.load_path(snapshot/name,logical_path=name).records
 post=loader.load_path(root/name,logical_path=name).records
 assert len(baseline)==len(pre)==len(post)
 counts[name]=0
 for b,p,a in zip(baseline,pre,post):
  b,p,a=map(clean,(b,p,a)); key=(name,a.get('section'),a.get('source'),a.get('source_tag'))
  if b!=a:
   assert key in allowed,key
   assert {k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!='target'}=={k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!='target'},key
   assert b['target']!=a['target']; counts[name]+=1; changed.append(allowed[key]['entry_revision_identity'])
  if p!=a:
   assert key in allowed and allowed[key]['entry_revision_identity']==finding['revision_key']
   assert {k:v for k,v in p.items() if k!='target'}=={k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!='target'}
   assert p['target'].count(old)==1 and a['target']==p['target'].replace(old,new,1)
   delta.append(dict(revision=finding['revision_key'],file=name,before=p['target'],after=a['target']))
assert len(changed)==106 and set(changed)=={e['entry_revision_identity'] for e in work}
assert len(delta)==1
for name in files:
 if name!=item['normalized_path']: assert (snapshot/name).read_bytes()==(root/name).read_bytes()
result=dict(result='passed',changed_targets=106,counts_by_file=counts,review_cycle_1_delta=1,other_records_unchanged=True,args_order_unchanged=True,only_adjudicated_replacement_changed=True,delta=delta,snapshot_path=str(snapshot))
(root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-w68-20261012/EXECUTOR-R2-VALIDATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY","max_output_tokens":2000}));
